⚠ OPERATIONAL RULES

These challenges are deliberately less guided than standard training.

  • Test boundary values as well as ordinary values.
  • Check the order of your conditions carefully.
  • Use brackets to make complex logic unambiguous.
  • Only mark a task complete after the program runs and its output matches the brief.

FINAL CLASSIFIED BRIEF
Build the Aegis access gate
The gate must verify a location, encryption cycle and countermeasure duel before reporting its decision.
  1. Ask for integer X and Y coordinates.
  2. Report ON BORDER or the correct quadrant.
  3. Ask for a year and classify it as LEAP or COMMON.
  4. Generate a drone code from 1 to 3 using random.
  5. Ask the agent for their code using the same Rock, Paper, Scissors mapping.
  6. Report WIN, LOSE or DRAW.
  7. Print one clearly labelled Aegis Gate report.
